home.vision: We merge high-fidelity web design with the implementation of robust systems. We develop custom proposals that turn complexity into efficiency, ensuring your digital foundation is always seamless, scalable, and flawless.

step1.title: Pain Study
step1.desc: Every brilliant architecture is born from a limiting problem. Before any line of code or infrastructure, we dive into the root of your corporate pain to understand exactly what bottlenecks are consuming your resources, corrupting your routine, and shielding your company's natural scale.

step2.title: Precise Diagnosis
step2.desc: In a tactical alignment meeting, we expose operational weaknesses on a transparent map. We dissect the architectural requirements to perfectly tie the necessary technologies with existing processes. We trace essential connectors communicating with crucial CRMs and ERPs.

step3.title: Solution Proposal
step3.desc: We present the definitive map. A customized technical foundation that centralizes disordered operations without bottlenecks or rigid dependency. We validate the model, infrastructure speed (Cloud), assertive scope, and the tailored deployment plan for you to scale immediately.

manifesto.p1: We do not believe in the comfort of the surface: while businesses delegate total control of their management to closed software offered by the market, ruptures become inevitable when subjected to disproportionate force. Companies lose massive base retention in boring "contact log failures" or third-party API crashes.
manifesto.p2: Your team demands ruthless automation built on modular foundations. Assuming end-to-end responsibility – from the invisible Bash Script running under virtual servers in the ecosystem to the complex hook capturing the ideal client – growth stabilizes. And that's what robust management does: predictability.

intro.machine_desc: With a solid foundation in Systems Analysis and Development, my technical approach goes down to the metal. I manage complex environments of virtual Linux cloud servers, Docker containerized infrastructures, and transactional databases, ensuring the entire base supporting heavy data workflows never yields under extreme stress.
intro.value_desc: But technology is just a means. I combine this relentless architectural execution with Management focused on the commercial client lifecycle. Dozens of asynchronous automations, corporate REST integrations, and native customization in top CRMs (Kommo, Pipedrive) are shaped to ensure one thing: your business won't lose money or leads down the drain of human inefficiency.

dev_section.quote: My technical approach goes beyond writing code; it's about <1>orchestrating systems that scale</1>. I have solid experience in developing full-stack applications and integration architecture.
dev_section.php_desc: From pure scripts to robust backends for APIs — complete mastery of the PHP lifecycle, focusing on security, performance, and integration with transactional databases.
dev_section.js_desc: React / Next.js to create responsive, high-performance interfaces. Typed componentization, SSR/SSG, and efficient API consumption with minimal latency.
dev_section.footer: I don't just implement features — <1>I resolve infrastructure and data bottlenecks</1>, ensuring the back-end and front-end communicate with minimal latency and maximum security. Whether creating custom plugins, integrating complex APIs, or developing <3>tailor-made SaaS</3>, my focus is always on efficiency, testability, and direct impact on business results.

portfolio.section3_title_highlight: Is Born from a Real Problem.
portfolio.section3_desc: We don't come with a ready-made solution. We come with questions. Every project begins with a deep dive into the client's operation — because the ideal technology only appears after understanding the workflow with clinical depth.

step1.title: Business Immersion
step1.desc: Before any keyboard, we sit with you. We understand who your team is, how they work today, where bottlenecks appear, and what your operation demands but doesn't yet receive. This phase isn't a briefing meeting — it's a clinical analysis of your business.
items: The team's real routine — how tasks arrive, how they leave, and where they die
Tools in use, broken integrations, and critical manual processes
Where the client gets lost and where revenue leaks unnoticed
Data volume, access frequency, and hidden operational risks

step2.title: Workflow Mapping
step2.desc: With the diagnosis in hand, we translate the problem into architecture. We design the data flow, automation points, and necessary integrations — all documented in a technical map that you can read and validate before approving a single line of code.
step2.list_title: What we deliver in this phase
items: Visual map of the operational workflow before and after the solution
Definition of technologies — driven by necessity, not trends
Integration points with existing systems (CRM, ERP, APIs)
Closed scope, realistic schedule, and objective success criteria

step3.title: Custom Solution
step3.desc: Only then do we build. Every component is designed to solve exactly the problem identified in the immersion — no superfluous features, no unnecessary costs. Delivery includes training, documentation, and support until your team operates with complete autonomy.
items: System running in the real environment — not in an isolated demo
Active automations connecting capture, operations, and CRM in real-time
Technical documentation and usage videos for the entire team
Post-delivery support and a refinement window at no extra cost

solarCase.purpose_desc: To facilitate the reservation process for clients and centralize the entire administrative operation into a single intuitive and powerful interface. Solar da Colina is a modern full-stack platform developed for complete reservation management and administration of a high-traffic hospitality property.
admin_items: <1>Overview Dashboard:</1> Instant metrics on occupancy rates, revenue, and tasks of the day.
<1>Interactive Calendar:</1> Fast visual management to view availability on the timeline and force blocks.
<1>Kanban Board:</1> Agile system to move reservations based on status (Pending, Negotiation, Check-in, Completed).
<1>Dynamic Pricing Management:</1> Tariff rules setup based on high/low season and scalable additional fees.
<1>iCal Synchronization:</1> Integration with external platforms like Airbnb and Booking.com.
<1>Check-in Management:</1> Extremely streamlined flow for fast guest reception and invoice issuance.
<1>User Control:</1> Access and permission management to ensure operational control.
client_items: <1>Accommodation Catalog:</1> Rich and detailed visualization of hosting options, including Camping, Rooms, and Chalets.
<1>Reservation System:</1> Minimalist and fast flow, from choosing the date on the calendar to final payment confirmation.
<1>Customer Panel:</1> Invoice history, past reservations, and fluid logged-in profile administration.
<1>Policies & Support:</1> Informative pages about house rules and contact channels with the team.
